summary: Batch Magic Scan (Boat Inventory) tested end-to-end at mobile 390x844 as the Pro user (session_token=test_session_pro_1) on own boat TEST_Kia Ora. Everything requested passed. Covered: the '++' button next to '+'; the form's validation (no name, no photo, duplicate name in the same batch, case-insensitive); photo preview; 'Confirm, and add another' resets the form; the real 3-area flow with sequential scans (progress went 'Scanning image 1 of 3 · 2 waiting' -> 2 -> 3 -> 'All scans finished · 0 of 3 reviewed', about 41s); tick gating and row validation (qty 0 and duplicate names rejected); 'Done' vs 'Confirm Batch' label; batch-confirm-btn disabled until all entries are ticked; Confirm Batch added 3 areas with 30 items, all onboard, including the edited row 'TEST Edited tool x7', and the toast showed '3 boat areas added with 30 items'. Also covered: data persisted after a reload; deleting a 'Waiting to scan' entry through the confirm prompt; the discard dialog (Keep going / Discard / Escape), where discarding added nothing; offline toast 'Batch Magic Scan needs a signal'; replace warning in the form and in the entry, where confirming replaced the existing area's 8 items with 1 and created no duplicate area; single Magic Scan regression (scan-review-dialog with 9 rows, replace warning, Save contents, toast); and scans_left reaching 49/48/47, which confirms the 50 daily limit. No horizontal overflow in the batch dialog or form (scrollWidth equals clientWidth), and the list scrolls (overflow-y auto, 2272 > 483). 4 real AI calls were used. The discard, delete and replace flows used a mocked /scan route via page.route, so they made no AI calls. All TEST_ areas were deleted afterwards, which was checked in the DB.

issues: When a batch entry replaces an existing area, the toast still says '1 boat area added with N items'. 'updated' or 'replaced' would be more accurate (minor wording).

action_items: Optional: say 'replaced/updated' in the batch toast when entries replace existing areas
Optional: when the batch is discarded or an entry is deleted mid-scan, the request still in flight still uses up a daily scan (no AbortController). Consider aborting it.
critical_code_review_comments: useBatchScan: an in-flight scan is not aborted on discard, delete or unmount. The result is safely ignored, but the quota is still used.
BatchScanDialog.finish: if checkRows fails, the entry is unticked silently with no error message. This is practically unreachable because ticked rows can't be edited, so it is fine.
Inventory area delete uses the ConfirmDelete default testId 'media-delete-*'. Consider using 'inventory-area-delete-*' for clarity.
seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_Tool locker, TEST_Wall rack and TEST_Third were created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro user's own boat is 'TEST_Kia Ora', and its Boat Inventory is empty. Use page.route('**/api/boats/*/scan') with fulfill to mock AI scans and avoid quota or latency.
